title: The lines behind the 11 CodeQL alerts of release #474 keep their results: quickstart batch tools, the agent-tools build script and the tests that escaped by hand
steps: S1: From the repository root run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/test/batch-contracts.test.mjs scripts/test/agent-tools.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/site-context.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/site-link-pacing.test.mjs scripts/test/tracy-web-comment-turn-image.test.mjs vendor/emdash/tracy-emdash-skill/skills/tracy-emdash-template/scripts/tests/compile-seed.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines.

selectors.batch-contracts: the --design pattern, the gunzip restore through run's stdoutFile, the URL pair and notes cell escapes (packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/batch-contracts.mjs)

evidence: CodeQL check of the release PR #474: polynomial regular expression and shell command from environment values in batch-contracts.mjs, incomplete escaping in batch-contracts.mjs, scripts/build-agent-tools.mjs and three tests, identity replacement in the vendored compile-seed.test.mjs.
fence: Mechanism only: the changed lines give the same results through their tests. Not covered: the CodeQL run itself (no CodeQL CLI on the machine) and a Joomla/WordPress restore on a live stand.
